infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Flux turns what people around you say into sign language. Speech is recognised on this device.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Flux listens to speech around you so it can be signed and captioned.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Flux connects to the signing server on your local network.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Flux watches your hands so your signing can be turned into speech. Video stays on this phone and your own server.
